title: gate-live notice event
description: E12 L1 (row 29.2): a non-red fact an agent must hear while the gate stays green, such as a withheld producer offer. Never a failure: no red count, outlook, first-red time, harvest slice or sibling red reads it. It lives here, beside its only consumer (gate-live-schema.test.mjs), and not in elohim/sdk/schemas/v1/gate-live-event.schema.json, because that directory is a storage build source: editing it would roll Edge for a device-local vocabulary. Moving the whole gate-live schema out of elohim/sdk is on the deliberate-Edge-roll list. The envelope fields are the v1 event schema's own.

class.description: Source of truth: the notice vocabulary. offer-withheld: the device's gate is green but it offers nothing it built to siblings.

text.description: One device-local line, as printed; it never crosses to another device.
